description: Read the transaction count (nonce) of a 0x address on Arbitrum One, both confirmed and including pending transactions. Use to build the next transaction or to tell whether an address has ever sent anything; for its balance use arb_balance. A malformed address is rejected with 400, uncharged. Example: address=0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: arb_nonce
title: Arbitrum One account nonce
